scope: synthetic installed48 boundary through component, direct-LFE priming, Type10, point targets, receiver and fitting QMF

state_schema.source: derived from canonical semantic constructors and the F04C composition owner
state_schema.variant_reason: LfeDelayRingState rows/input_frame_indexes change from None to bytes/int as slots are written; all variants are explicit and are not inferred from hash equality.

recipe_definitions.rounding_and_order: Every rational is converted once to IEEE binary32 nearest-even. Rows then samples are packed F32LE. mod is nonnegative integer modulo.
recipe_definitions.installed48_g2_to_g5: base=R32((mod(sample*(row+5)+17*g+row,193)-96)/65536); if mod(sample+row+g,29)=0 replace with positive zero
recipe_definitions.matrix: Each of 15 rows has +0.5 at column (3r+g) mod48 and +0.25 at column(first+17) mod48; destination=(r+g) mod15.
recipe_definitions.lfe: source_index=min(g,1); for sample0..1535 value=R32((mod(5*sample+19*source_index,101)-50)/8192); therefore g2..g5 reproduce g1 bytes
recipe_definitions.phase_and_valid_count: g0 NORMAL valid1536; g1 NORMAL valid731; g2..g5 CACHED_DRAIN valid0. Raw padding/caching is upstream of installed48.
